nodes.speaker: voice_ledger
nodes.text: Dates. There are dates on that wall.

nodes.speaker: voice_ledger
nodes.text: The notices are not in order. One from March is stapled over one from June, and the June one is still dry.

nodes.speaker: voice_ledger
nodes.text: Three notices, three dates, going down. It adds up.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: It adds up to nothing. The bottom notice is upside down, and someone has written a time on the back of it in a different pen.

nodes.speaker: voice_echo
nodes.text: This one. This yard. I know this one.

nodes.speaker: voice_echo
nodes.text: The court, the shed, the gate at the far end. It fits the way a room fits a photograph of it. I cannot find the day.

nodes.speaker: voice_echo
nodes.text: In the evening. You were here in the evening, with someone, and the light was going.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You cannot find the evening. The yard is empty and the light is going now, and the whole shape of the place still feels borrowed.

nodes.speaker: voice_boundary
nodes.text: Let me look at that.

nodes.speaker: voice_boundary
nodes.text: The hoop is low, and its pole stands in concrete that is newer than the yard. The old holes are still there, filled and painted over. This hoop has been moved.

nodes.speaker: voice_boundary
nodes.text: The hoop is at the height a hoop is. There will be a rule about it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: You do not know the rule. The pole is set in a patch of concrete that is a different colour from the rest of the yard, and the net is newer than the rim.

nodes.speaker: voice_onlooker
nodes.text: Someone left that.

nodes.speaker: voice_onlooker
nodes.text: Zipped shut, set square on the seat, handles up. Whoever left it put it where the gate could see it. That is not how you leave something you are coming back for.

nodes.speaker: voice_onlooker
nodes.text: They will be back in a minute. People always come back for a bag.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The bench has been rained on since. The bag is wet on top and dry underneath, so it has not been moved, and it has been here longer than a minute.

nodes.speaker: voice_echo
nodes.text: You have climbed this before.

nodes.speaker: voice_echo
nodes.text: The third rung gives a little, and the top bar is worn where hands go. You have climbed this before, in a yard with a different wall behind it.

nodes.speaker: voice_echo
nodes.text: This is the frame from the yard by the river. Same paint, same bend in the top bar.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is no river here. You remember the bend, though, and you cannot say from where, and that is worse than not remembering it at all.
